daysToHarvestRange.notes: Days measured from transplanting, not sowing. Corroborated by DAFF: 'A long growing season of 80 days is required for the transplanted crop' and 'Harvest of eggplant usually starts 75 to 90 days after transplanting' (same DALRRD brochure, p5/p8), and by Starke Ayres' Black King and Violet Moon cultivars, both quoted as '70 - 80 days to first pick after transplanting'.

yield.conditions: Conservative 12-15 t/ha, likely 20 t/ha, target 25 t/ha under good commercial management (KZN)

evidence.doc: KZN DARD, 'Expected Yields' (Vegetable Production series), Table 8

varieties.name: Black King
varieties.maturity: 70-80 days to first pick after transplanting
varieties.notes: Large oval fruit (500-600g), dark purple, early cultivar; recommended plant population 18,000-25,000/ha, row spacing 0.9-1.5m x in-row 45-90cm (Starke Ayres, Eggplant Production Guideline 2019, p2-3). Supplier does not attribute the cultivar to a specific SA zone.

varieties.name: Violet Moon
varieties.maturity: 70-80 days to first pick after transplanting
varieties.notes: Medium half-long fruit (300-500g), spineless calyx, early cultivar; same population/spacing recommendation as Black King. Supplier does not attribute the cultivar to a specific SA zone.

zoneNotes: Starke Ayres' Eggplant Production Guideline (2019) gives explicit establishment periods by region: 'Lowveld – February to May', 'Middleveld – September to December', 'Highveld (cold areas) – October to November', 'Western Cape – October to December' (p3). Its commercial row spacing (0.9-1.5m) is wider than KZN DARD's Table 5 figure (700-800mm row), reflecting different production intensities/mechanisation assumptions between the two sources; both are reported rather than reconciled into a single number.
gaps: Seed rate in kg/ha not available as a standalone figure because brinjal is normally transplanted: KZN DARD's Table 5 gives only seedtray (140-200g) and seedbed (300-500g) rates, plus a 3kg/ha figure for the atypical direct-sown case, none of which is an appropriate single 'seed rate per ha' value for a transplanted crop.

DAFF/DALRRD's 'Brochure Eggplant' (2011) leans on general/US extension references (e.g. USDA, ARS Magazine) for some of its content rather than SA field trial data, so it was used only to corroborate transplant-to-harvest timing, not as the sole source for any core number.
summary: All four rain-pattern sowMonths, daysToHarvestRange, row+in-row spacing and yield are sourced from KZN DARD's Vegetable Production series (Tables 4, 5, 6, 8), corroborated by the DAFF/DALRRD 2011 Eggplant brochure and Starke Ayres' 2019 Eggplant Production Guideline (which also supplied the Western Cape winter sowing window and two named cultivars).
